componentDefinitionId.description: Stable built-in or content-addressed component definition used by this instance. Older v7 projects may omit it and receive it during validation.

acResistance.description: Optional positive resistor value used only in AC analysis; when omitted, the ordinary resistance applies.

tc1.description: Optional signed ngspice first-order passive temperature coefficient (TC1).

tc2.description: Optional signed ngspice second-order passive temperature coefficient (TC2).

tce.description: Optional signed ngspice exponential temperature coefficient (TCE) for resistor-based parts.

noiseEnabled.description: Whether this resistor-based component contributes thermal and flicker noise; omitted means enabled.

y.description: ELSim-authored scene coordinates are normalized to the 10-unit editor grid. Imported source geometry retains its original coordinates.

mosfetGeometry.description: Optional positive MOSFET channel and junction geometry plus nonnegative drain/source diffusion squares, emitted as native ngspice instance parameters.

bjtArea.description: Optional positive BJT emitter, base, and collector junction area factors for this transistor instance.

instanceMultiplier.description: Optional positive ngspice passive-device, semiconductor, or subcircuit instance multiplier.

diodeArea.description: Optional positive ngspice diode junction-area scale; combines multiplicatively with M.

diodePerimeter.description: Optional positive ngspice diode junction-perimeter scale; combines multiplicatively with M.

fetAreaFactor.description: Optional positive dimensionless ngspice JFET/MESFET instance area factor.

deviceTemperatureDelta.description: Optional ngspice DTEMP offset in degrees Celsius from the circuit temperature.

deviceTemperature.description: Optional absolute ngspice instance TEMP in degrees Celsius; mutually exclusive with deviceTemperatureDelta.

initialOff.description: Ask ngspice to start its DC operating-point iteration with this nonlinear semiconductor device off.

switchInitialState.description: Optional initial state for an ngspice SW/CSW device when its control begins inside the hysteresis band; defaults to off.

substrateNode.description: Optional labeled substrate node for an ngspice NPN or PNP transistor; omitted means ngspice's default ground substrate.

sourceMode.description: For transient analysis, sources support pulse, DC, PWL, SINE, EXP, SFFM, and AM. Experimental TRNOISE is supported on voltage sources only. Omitted voltage-source mode preserves historical pulse behavior; omitted current-source mode means scalar DC.

acMagnitude.description: Optional per-source small-signal AC magnitude; overrides the project default for voltage sources and the DC value for current sources.

acPhase.description: Optional per-source small-signal AC phase in degrees; defaults to zero.

cycleCount.description: Optional nonnegative whole number of pulses; zero or omission means repeat indefinitely.

pulse.description: Optional LTspice-compatible voltage or current pulse level, timing, and cycle count; omitted fields use the ELSim default pulse.

sine.description: Optional voltage/current-source transient SINE settings: offset and amplitude in the source quantity, frequency, delay, damping factor, and phase degrees.

exp.description: Optional transient EXP source settings: initial and pulsed source quantity, rise delay/time constant, and fall delay/time constant.

sffm.description: LTspice SFFM source settings: offset, amplitude, carrier frequency, modulation index, and modulating signal frequency.

flickerExponent.description: 1/f noise exponent, between 0 and 2 when flicker noise is enabled.

rtsCaptureTime.description: Mean trap capture time; required when RTS amplitude is nonzero.

rtsEmissionTime.description: Mean trap emission time; required when RTS amplitude is nonzero.

trnoise.description: Experimental ngspice transient-noise source settings for voltage sources only.

pwl.description: Piecewise-linear voltage source points in strictly increasing time order.

pwlFileName.description: Filename from a user-provided LTspice PWL data file; its parsed point values are stored in the project.

pwlRepeat.description: Repeat a voltage- or current-source PWL point sequence forever.

pwlRepeatCount.description: Repeat a voltage- or current-source PWL point sequence this many times in total. Finite repeats require matching first and last levels; expanded source tables are limited to 32 points.

currentPwl.description: Piecewise-linear independent current source points in strictly increasing time order.

animationNominalPower.description: Nominal electrical power in watts used only to scale the illustrative lamp brightness or resistor power glow.

polarized.description: Render a positive and negative terminal marker on a polarized capacitor.

turnsRatio.description: Positive secondary-to-primary turns ratio for the built-in coupled-inductor transformer.

coupling.description: Magnetic coupling coefficient greater than zero and at most one for the built-in coupled-inductor transformer.

seriesResistance.description: Optional nonnegative series resistance (ohms) for capacitor ESR or inductor winding loss.

coefficient.description: Dimensionless magnetic coupling coefficient greater than zero and at most one; valid only for inductors. The first listed inductor terminals are the dotted terminals.

mutualCoupling.description: Legacy optional single mutual coupling; project validation upgrades it to mutualCouplings.

coefficient.description: Dimensionless magnetic coupling coefficient greater than zero and at most one. The first listed terminal of each inductor is the dotted terminal.

mutualCouplings.description: Optional outgoing pairwise couplings to other inductors in this sheet; multiple records allow multi-winding magnetic networks.

primaryWindingResistance.description: Optional nonnegative series resistance in ohms for a built-in transformer's primary winding.

secondaryWindingResistance.description: Optional nonnegative series resistance in ohms for a built-in transformer's secondary winding.

wiperPosition.description: Potentiometer wiper fraction from upper terminal to lower terminal, from 0.001 to 0.999.

transmissionLine.description: ngspice lossless T-line length specified by propagation delay or frequency and normalized electrical length.

urcLine.description: Per-unit-length parameters and section count for ngspice's native URC distributed RC line.

voltageSwitch.description: Optional voltage-controlled switch parameters; omitted values use 1 Ω, 1 GΩ, and 0 V defaults.

currentSwitch.description: Optional current-controlled switch parameters; omitted values use 1 Ω, 1 GΩ, and 0 A defaults.
